title: Diane Powell takes on John Mack's legacy and a synchronous Oregon house
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Diane Powell takes on John Mack's legacy and a synchronous Oregon house, about 2004 onward at London; Oregon, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels tells how John Mack, a psychiatrist who studied people who said they had met aliens, was tragically hit by a car and killed in London in 2004. According to Michels, when psychiatrist Diane Powell went to his memorial, people there urged her to take up Mack's legacy, and the story goes on to a house in Oregon tied to striking coincidences. It is told as how Powell came to her own work on the mind's unexplained abilities.
